bio: matcha & movement 🍵 | slow mornings, strength training, real food | LA → Tokyo → wherever | DMs open for collabs

posts.caption: 5am club but make it aesthetic. miso soup, matcha latte, 20 min of something that gets my heart rate up before the world wakes up. this is the routine that changed everything for me #morningroutine #matchalife #5amclub #slowmorning #wellness

finally found the protein bar that doesn't taste like chalk or sweetener overload. real ingredients, nothing weird. @oatlyusa oat milk pairing is *chef's kiss* #cleaneating #proteinbar #realfood #healthysnacks

tokyo grocery haul 🗾 everything i picked up at natural lawson + the organic market in daikanyama. they do functional food so differently here — adaptogens on every shelf, fermented everything. obsessed. #tokyo #japanfood #adaptogen #fermentedfoods #groceryhaul

strength > cardio and i will die on this hill. 3x/week lifting, walking everywhere, occasional yoga when my nervous system needs it. no 75 hard, no rules — just consistency #strengthtraining #liftingwomen #functionalfitness #moveyourbody

the ceramics i commissioned from @porcelain.studio arrived and i cannot stop moving them around the apartment. wabi-sabi everything. nothing matching. #ceramics #wabiSabi #slowliving #interiors #handmade

things i actually spend money on: quality olive oil, a gym membership in whatever city i'm in, books i'll read twice, and that one matcha powder that costs $40. unbothered. #worthit #qualityoverquantity #intentionalliving

collab with @sunpotionherbs on their new ashwagandha blend — been taking adaptogens for 2 years now and the difference in cortisol response is real (got tested, not vibes). code MAEVE for 20% off #adaptogens #ashwagandha #stressrelief #holistichealth #ad

reading rec: The Body Keeps the Score changed how i think about rest. not being dramatic — i now treat sleep like training. blackout curtains, no screens, 68 degrees. boring? maybe. transformed? yes. #bookrecommendation #sleephealth #recovery #wellness

farmer's market every saturday without exception. building relationships with the people who grow your food is underrated. this week's haul: ugly tomatoes, hon shimeji mushrooms, raw honey. #farmersmarket #localfood #seasonaleating #communitymarket

new @aesop face routine is quietly running my life. the whole ritual — the smell, the texture, the 3 minutes where you just exist at the sink. #skincare #aesop #skincareroutine #cleanskin #beautyrituals

the only supplement stack i'd recommend: magnesium glycinate at night, creatine post-lift, and whatever adaptogen you can actually afford to be consistent with. that's it. don't let supplement companies sell you a $200/month habit #supplementstack #fitness #wellness
osaka → kyoto by shinkansen and i genuinely want to live my entire life at this speed #japan #shinkansen #travel #slowtravel

weekly meal prep but make it feel like a ritual not a chore. @merchantgourmet grains, roasted root veg, tahini on everything. the goal is a fridge that makes future-me feel taken care of #mealprep #healthyeating #batchcooking #foodprep
walked 18k steps today without trying. just saying the city-as-gym thing is real. no gym membership needed if you refuse elevators and love a long errand #walking #activelifestyle #citylife #steps

@thriva_ bloodwork results in — vitamin D and iron both where they should be for the first time in years. eat your liver, take your magnesium, sleep 8 hours. the unsexy basics win every time. #functionalhealth #bloodwork #biohacking #womenshealth
